caption:
Comment BLUEPRINT and I'll send it over: the whole faceless model, written out.

Recurring income isn't luck. It's a loop. The offer you pick, the post you make, the person who clicks. Get the loop right, and it pays you without you touching it again.

THE FIVE STEPS

1. Pick the offer. Recurring, not one-time.
2. Build one angle. Say it the same way every time.
3. Post without your face. Screen recording, text over footage, or a voice reading a script.
4. Let the loop run. Stop checking it every hour.
5. Repeat the pattern. One post proves nothing, ten posts start one.

WHY THIS ACTUALLY WORKS

Every post is a signal. Repeat the same angle enough times, and the platform starts treating it as your lane. It starts showing that lane to the people who'd actually want it. You don't just make content. You train the system that decides who sees you.

THE HONEST PART

I'm not going to tell you what you'll make. I don't know you, and I don't know how hard you'll work.

It could be zero. Post once and stop, and it's zero. This is a loop, not a lottery ticket.

But choose it, repeat it, and it becomes the thing the algorithm trusts.
